declaration.argument: Only how queued work is laid out and where per-step index lists are stored change. Records, timers, channel sends and partition types sit behind one pointer inside a queued runnable, with the record's priority copied beside the pointer by a constructor that is the only way to queue a record, so the copy equals the record's own priority bit for bit; the scheduler's per-step eligible and queue-size lists hold the same indices in the same order in inline storage. No draw, selection, container order, value, row or anything the search reads changes. One-thread identity against the baseline binary on VR (3,008 runs, both commits), Mencius (2,160 runs) and a caps-engaged VR run of 100,000 runs: runs, executions, logs and traces identical both ways, same stall_cap_runs.csv hashes, equal end reasons and cap figures; the exact per-run identity async record boxes + timer boxes + make() channels = channels_created holds on every run and arm.
